raw.query: WITH trace AS (SELECT e.value_num AS trace_images_per_request FROM provenance.eda_metric e JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id=e.run_id AND d.is_current=true WHERE e.run_id='eda:b_marginals' AND e.metric_path='numimages.mean_images_per_request_overall'), steady AS (SELECT d.run_id,d.window_name,d.window_span_s,d.window_requests,d.policy,l.sla_metric,l.n_requests,l.p99_ms,l.queue_divergent,d.is_current,d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l ON l.run_id=d.run_id AND l.is_current=true WHERE d.is_current=true AND d.window_name='steady24h' AND d.experiment='a2' AND d.pool='both') SELECT (SELECT trace_images_per_request FROM trace) AS trace_images_per_request, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steady) AS steady_latency_rows, (SELECT json_agg(steady ORDER BY run_id) FROM steady) AS steady_rows
raw.observed: trace_images_per_request=14.33217; steady24h denominator=88,260 requests across 8 current a2 both-pool rows; p99 encoder delay=548.363–733.643 ms
